Based on winit 0.30.13. Linux/X11 XDND accepts HTTP(S) and data:image URIs from browser image drags, preserving escaped URL bytes. It also negotiates plain-text URL offers and binary PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP offers used by browsers such as Brave. Binary payloads are transported as data URIs through the existing PathBuf-based HoveredFile/DroppedFile events; PaintAtlas confirms and fetches/decodes them off the UI thread. Local file URI decoding and canonicalization remain supported. URI-list comments and localhost file URIs are accepted. Regression tests live in platform_impl/linux/x11/paintatlas_drop.rs.
The accepted XDND action is Copy, so a source file is never moved or deleted and browsers receive the expected copy action.
